cards.title: Google DeepMind Launches Gemini Robotics 2: Whole-Body Control, Dexterity, and Multi-Robot Collaboration
cards.why_it_matters: As an AI/ML engineer, this is a flagship DeepMind release combining VLA models, embodied reasoning, and on-device adaptation — directly advancing the state of physical AI and robotics research.
cards.summary: DeepMind introduces three models: Gemini Robotics 2 (VLA for full humanoid control including legs and dexterous hands/grippers), Gemini Robotics ER 2 (VLM for multi-step planning and multi-robot teamwork), and Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 (efficient VLA with fast adaptation to new robot bodies in a few hours of data). ER 2 is available on Google AI Studio; VLA models are in early-access partner preview.
